tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and the main content area.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header bar, chat panel, inputs.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Hover fills, table header rows, user chat bubbles, quoted email text.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Left navigation and chat-history panel.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls: secondary buttons, inputs, composer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-canvas, bg-surface, bg-subtle and bg-sidebar.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, metadata, timestamps, inactive nav items. Passes 4.5:1 on every background token.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Coffee. Primary buttons, active states, links, progress, the send button. Text-safe on bg-surface, bg-canvas and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Active nav item fill, AI avatar, brand badges. Pair with brand text.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every focusable control.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: The vacation banner and avatar fills. The warm 'away' colour; use once per screen.

tokens.name: sand-border
tokens.usage: Outline of sand surfaces.

tokens.name: roast
tokens.usage: Deep espresso identity colour for the cover and marketing. Not used in product UI.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Caramel identity accent for the logo sun and the cover. Never used for text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Sent, approved, rule passed. Text on success-soft or bg-surface.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Awaiting approval, low confidence, knowledge expiring. Text on warning-soft or bg-surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Escalated, urgent, rejected, destructive actions. Text on danger-soft or bg-surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Delegated, informational, neutral system notices. Text on info-soft or bg-surface.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info badges.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page titles in empty states and full-width chat.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I drafted a reply using the approved project status.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, chat history items, email subjects.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Knowledge IDs, rule IDs, trace IDs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding, gap between stat cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, chat panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Main content padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Citation chips, AI avatar, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, chat bubbles, composer.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, counters, suggestion chips, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Chat panel when it overlays content below 1280px.

layout.note: Fixed column widths for the three-column shell. See the Layout section for breakpoints.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded left panel: navigation plus chat history.

tokens.name: sidebar-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed left panel (icons only), used at 1280-1439px when chat is open.

tokens.name: chat-width
tokens.usage: Default docked chat panel width.

tokens.name: chat-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest the chat panel may be resized to.

tokens.name: chat-max
tokens.usage: Widest the chat panel may be resized to.

tokens.name: content-min
tokens.usage: Main area never shrinks below this; collapse the sidebar first, then overlay the chat.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of dashboard content; centred beyond it.

tokens.name: chat-reading
tokens.usage: Max width of the message column when chat is expanded to full page.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header bar and chat panel header, so their bottom borders line up.
